module Base
{
    /* Bobcat -- generated by tools/write_definitions.py.

       mesh takes no extension and no media/ prefix; the engine adds both and
       probes .fbx, .glb then .x in MeshAssetManager. Ours is the .glb.

       animationsMesh is the vanilla entry, so the game animates these with
       Raccoon's own skeleton and animation set. That only works because the bind
       matrices in our .glb match the vanilla ones exactly -- tools/x_verify.py
       checks it. */

    model KWC_Bobcat
    {
        mesh = Skinned/KWC_Bobcat,
        shader = animalEffect,
        static = false,
        animationsMesh = Raccoon,
    }

    model KWC_BobcatKitten
    {
        mesh = Skinned/KWC_BobcatKitten,
        shader = animalEffect,
        static = false,
        animationsMesh = Raccoon,
    }

}
